# Buchao Zhan

<div class="about-role">AI for Science · Protein Intelligence · Computational Biology</div>

<div class="about-deck">
I am a PhD student at Xiamen University. My research lies at the intersection of artificial intelligence and computational biology, with growing interests in protein foundation models, protein sequence–structure modeling, generative protein design, and AI for scientific discovery.
</div>
